name: MovingSumNode
label: Moving Sum
description: Adds a column with the moving (sliding-window) sum of a numeric column. The window restarts for each partition.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to compute the moving sum for.

fields.name: WindowSize
fields.label: Window Size
fields.description: The number of rows in the sliding window. Defaults to 3.

fields.name: PartitionByColumns
fields.label: Partition By Columns
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns that define partitions. The moving sum restarts per partition.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the moving sum column. Defaults to '<ValueColumn>_MovingSum'.
